cases.name: BridgeError UUIDs uniquely identify errors created within the same clock millisecond
Unavailable UUID support has a monotonic preview fallback and cannot break error construction
ErrorHandler retains typed errors and reports sanitized fallbacks without raw SDK messages
Every FidelityPolicy enum switch rejects invalid boundary values while preserving valid durations
FormatRegistry instances own readiness and verification independently
Extension and MIME indexes build once per catalogue revision and rebuild only after a change
Injected Native loaders do not share module state and failed loads remain retryable
Promise race deadlines clear their timers and discard late caller results
Category factories instantiate only requested records and still expose the entire offline catalogue
Idle draft session TTL removes owned copies but claimed task inputs never expire
Copying draft sessions survive TTL and successful activity refreshes their idle deadline
Cleanup deadlines report pending ownership without deleting live or uncompleted resources
ServiceContainer preview construction calls no Native loader and owned scope shutdown leaves other scopes available
Independent converter VMs retain all formats, original route filters and quality ordering without cloning
Inline confirmation never starts automatically and uses the frozen approved submission
Submission throws clear UI authorization in finally and release the owned draft for retry
Temporary system Picker hide preserves its result while copy-time hide discards late data
TTL invalidates visible unsubmitted inputs and unsubscribes the page observer on hide
Task history stays at 100, protects active work, reuses original ordering and bounds timing caches
Native result cache preserves recency and releases only the oldest result at its bound
Six preview components have bounded local state and the page supplies four observed VMs
